title: Persona Attribute Purge Version — payload
description: Permanently remove earlier versions of one attribute that the maintainer kept because a profile pins them. The holder's override on retention: after a name change, the old name is kept only while something needs it, and this is how the holder says nothing does.

versions.description: The retained versions to remove. Omit to remove every retained version of the attribute. The current version is never removed by this task — that is persona/attribute/delete.

Response.title: Persona Attribute Purge Version — response payload
Response.description: Success response to persona/attribute/purge-version. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/persona/attribute/purge-version/1.0#response. Purging a version that is not held is a success that purges nothing, so a repeated purge converges.

purged.description: The versions actually removed. Empty when none named was held.

stalePins.description: Profiles that pinned a purged version and now present that entry as stale — which is to say, disclose nothing for it until the holder repins or edits them. Named because a purge that quietly shortened what three faces present is the surprise this family exists to prevent. Absent when none did.
